reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and replied to Anselm in his DM. The draft hasn't been sent; someone still has to send it from drafts.

The subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101-a-seat figure, says Marcus gave it and that Anselm approved sharing it. It also says the rate is proposed, not a signed term.

Hollis leads the Central team and doesn't own this account; Marcus Lindqvist does. So the rate needed Anselm's sign-off before it could go to Hollis, and his message gave it. The address is a pemberline.com one, so Ruth Calloway's approval wasn't needed.

I couldn't confirm the $2,101 figure anywhere. The company knowledge base (gbrain) only has the current signed rate, $1,700 a seat for 40 seats, with the term ending 2/28/27. It shows nothing on the 2027 proposal, so I used the number as Anselm stated it.
